scope: Structured, broad evidence map for IDA; not an exhaustive systematic review or a completed audit of every neuroscience dataset.
review_method: Targeted primary-source and official-repository searches on 8 September 2026, plus the prior IDA reanalyses. Repository entries describe candidate uses, not downloaded datasets. No pooled cross-domain correlations were computed.
completion: All listed records have a declared source and next-use boundary. Raw access, study-level risk-of-bias reviews and field-wide saturation remain incomplete.

failures.title: Selecting and testing on the same data
failures.problem: Feature, channel, window or subgroup selection can inflate the reported effect.
failures.repair: Nest every fitted choice; freeze a final external test.
failures.acceptance: No shared person, session or overlapping segment across the claimed test boundary.

failures.title: Motion becomes a brain network
failures.problem: Motion can generate systematic functional-connectivity patterns.
failures.repair: Keep motion and censoring records; test motion-only and matched-quality baselines.
failures.acceptance: Effect must survive prespecified quality sensitivity analyses.

failures.title: Muscle activity becomes high-frequency EEG
failures.problem: Scalp high-frequency activity can contain substantial muscle contributions.
failures.repair: Record EOG, movement and jaw/forehead artifact checks; retain raw signals.
failures.acceptance: Candidate must add value beyond artifact channels.

failures.title: Band power is equated with one oscillator
failures.problem: Aperiodic changes can alter power in a conventional band.
failures.repair: Compare periodic/aperiodic models; do not name a neurotransmitter from a band ratio.
failures.acceptance: Report the decomposition and sensitivity to fit choices.

failures.title: Small associations become personal predictions
failures.problem: Small population associations can be unstable under resampling.
failures.repair: Match sample-size design to the estimand; report uncertainty and external performance.
failures.acceptance: Do not claim every experiment needs thousands; repeated-person experiments are different designs.

failures.title: Pupil size becomes a unique transmitter meter
failures.problem: Pupil covariation is not a unique assay of one transmitter or circuit.
failures.repair: Measure luminance, gaze, blink, task and medication context.
failures.acceptance: Separate human proxy validation from animal mechanistic support.

failures.title: Scalp blood flow becomes cortical fNIRS
failures.problem: Systemic and superficial physiology can contaminate hemodynamic signals.
failures.repair: Include depth-sensitive controls and physiological regressors.
failures.acceptance: A compact optical sensor needs demonstrated cortical sensitivity.

failures.title: Training a signal is assumed to treat symptoms
failures.problem: A credible matched control is needed to isolate feedback-specific benefit.
failures.repair: Measure independent symptoms/function and blind assessment where feasible.
failures.acceptance: Learning the target is an intermediate outcome, not sufficient clinical success.

failures.title: Post-treatment physiology selects the earlier treatment
failures.problem: A measurement caused by treatment was unavailable at the earlier choice.
failures.repair: Time-stamp decision, feature cutoff, action and later outcome separately.
failures.acceptance: Use it only for a later sequential decision in a valid design.

failures.title: Prediction is substituted for treatment selection
failures.problem: A variable can predict poor outcomes under every action.
failures.repair: Estimate and validate treatment contrasts or policy value, not only outcome MAE.
failures.acceptance: Beat the best fixed action with comparable burden.

failures.title: Clock alignment is assumed from a streaming library
failures.problem: Transport timestamps do not remove all sensor, buffering and stimulus latency.
failures.repair: Retain raw counters and offsets; test physical marker latency.
failures.acceptance: State measured timing uncertainty at the relevant decision horizon.

failures.title: Diagnostic categories are treated as one mechanism
failures.status: Framework limitation, already recognized in the field
failures.problem: Clinical categories need not imply a single physiological cause.
failures.repair: Use dimensions and competing mechanisms while retaining clinical outcomes.
failures.acceptance: IDA must outperform existing dimensional and history-based models.

failures.title: A mouse or implanted-electrode effect is transported to a headband
failures.problem: Species, sampling geometry and available interventions change.
failures.repair: Require a paired measurement bridge and a separate noninvasive intervention test.
failures.acceptance: Conceptual similarity cannot substitute for a transport experiment.

failures.title: A resting atlas is treated as a controller
failures.problem: Control needs action-conditioned transitions and later consequences.
failures.repair: Collect repeated decision opportunities with assigned actions where justified.
failures.acceptance: Demonstrate incremental policy value and generalization after withdrawal.

routes.title: State-guided timing of an established behavioural input
routes.rationale: An existing input can have measurable effects; physiological guidance still needs its own contrast.
routes.next_test: Same input/content budget: fixed versus state-guided versus matched control.
routes.stop: No benefit over fixed delivery after withdrawal stops the personalization claim.

routes.title: EEG added to context, behaviour and peripheral physiology
routes.rationale: Scalp measurements can carry outcome information in defined settings.
routes.next_test: Incremental value, repeatability and treatment interaction in held-out sessions.
routes.stop: If simpler channels match performance, remove EEG from that use case.

routes.title: Respiration / HRV biofeedback with independent outcomes
routes.rationale: There is randomized evidence in specific populations; transfer is unresolved.
routes.next_test: Match instruction, attention and exposure; test the value of feedback timing.
routes.stop: A better HRV trace alone is insufficient.

routes.title: Cue- and phase-specific updating
routes.rationale: Opposite phase associations motivate temporal distinctions, not causal prescriptions.
routes.next_test: Sequential design with pre-decision variables and later intrusive-memory or function outcomes.
routes.stop: Do not infer a universal arousal optimum.

routes.title: Closed-loop sleep research
routes.rationale: EEG-timed sensory input has controlled experimental precedents.
routes.next_test: Verify phase timing, arousal burden and independent next-day outcomes.
routes.stop: No transfer to awake psychiatric treatment without separate evidence.

routes.title: Personalized invasive mapping
routes.rationale: Individualized recording and stimulation can support clinical improvement in selected cases.
routes.next_test: Use published evidence to constrain hypotheses; require a scalp bridge.
routes.stop: No invasive stimulation implementation in the headband.

routes.title: State-dependent cognitive-control intervention
routes.rationale: An invasive proof-of-concept compared closed- and open-loop behavioural effects.
routes.next_test: Test whether noninvasive measurements and permitted inputs preserve useful distinctions.
routes.stop: An implanted result cannot specify scalp stimulation parameters.

routes.title: tVNS and baseline-response interactions
routes.rationale: An emerging randomized study makes response heterogeneity a testable question.
routes.next_test: Independent confirmation of interaction and clinically reviewed device protocol.
routes.stop: No stimulation circuit or dosing in IDA R1.

routes.title: EEG neurofeedback for mental-health benefit
routes.rationale: Specific feedback effects require credible sham or active controls.
routes.next_test: Independent blinded outcome and adverse-burden comparison.
routes.stop: Changing a band ratio cannot be counted as symptom resolution.

routes.title: Neural mechanisms linked to redox / cancer
routes.rationale: Molecular datasets can constrain biology at tissue/cell scales.
routes.next_test: Paired measurements, defined cell types and independent causal perturbations.
routes.stop: Scalp signals cannot currently determine tumour redox or cancer intervention.

modalities.name: Scalp EEG
modalities.observes: Millisecond electrical mixtures at the scalp
modalities.limit: Reference dependence, spatial mixing, eye/muscle artifacts
modalities.decision: R1 candidate; six EEG plus two EOG channels

modalities.name: Intracranial EEG / spikes / DBS
modalities.observes: Local electrical activity at selected sites
modalities.strength: Direct local signals; possible causal perturbations

modalities.name: fMRI / ASL
modalities.limit: Motion, vascular effects, slow observation operator

modalities.name: Structural / diffusion MRI
modalities.limit: Tract estimates are not measured directed control paths

modalities.name: PET / MRS
modalities.limit: Cost, radiation for PET, spatial/temporal constraints

modalities.name: ECG / PPG / respiration / EDA
modalities.methods: Beat intervals, respiration coupling, event responses
modalities.limit: Motion, context, breathing and nonunique physiology

modalities.name: Pupillometry / gaze / EOG
modalities.observes: Pupil diameter, eye direction and electrical eye activity
modalities.limit: Lighting, blinks, effort, task and drug effects
modalities.decision: EOG on R1; calibrated camera is optional external module

modalities.name: Behaviour / self-report / EMA
modalities.methods: State-space, survival, mixed-effects and causal models
modalities.limit: Measurement reactivity, burden and report bias

modalities.name: Cellular / calcium / connectomics
modalities.observes: Spikes, calcium proxy, cellular and synaptic structure
modalities.limit: Species, sampling, calcium kinetics and scale transfer
modalities.decision: Hypothesis constraints, not personal state labels

modalities.name: Transcriptomics / proteomics / genetics
modalities.observes: Molecular abundance, variation and cell identity
modalities.methods: Differential expression, association and pathway models
modalities.limit: Tissue, batch, composition and causal ambiguity

open_coverage: Language/speech and social-interaction datasets need deeper review.
Pain, autonomic disorders, developmental differences and medication interactions need dedicated reviews.
No comprehensive trial-registry search, screening flow or meta-analysis has been completed.
Scalp–intracranial, genetics–physiology and sensor–symptom bridges require paired data.
Dataset sizes, licenses, consent and access must be confirmed at asset level before retrieval.
Manufacturing, human fit, electrical safety, clinical efficacy and treatment optimization remain unvalidated.
